source_title: Why World War 3 Is Becoming a Structural Fight
summary: This May 2026 Diary of a CEO interview is a dense forecast-comparison source: Jiang ties Iran war, petrodollar defense, Eurasian rail alternatives, Malacca/First Island Chain pressure, domestic emergency-power politics, AI surveillance, Greater Israel, Taiwan/Japan risk, imperial collapse timing, and relational creative practice into one public structural-war frame.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The war is treated as defense of reserve-currency order: retreat from Iran would expose the petrodollar, Treasury demand, and allied trading obedience as fragile.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Chokepoint anchor already owns no-exit war when dollar protection, route control, allied belief, and exit cost make withdrawal more dangerous than escalation.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Iran's mountain fortress, pressure points, Hormuz exposure, GCC energy, desalination, food, and global-cost shock make the war an access-system problem rather than a quick decapitation campaign.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source should strengthen Chokepoint's strait and no-exit chronology before any new Iran-war public prose.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: AI surveillance appears as total online recording, database inference, behavioral control, and eventual digital permission rather than just a technology theme.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Mass Society owns this when the mechanism is population-scale identity, data, prediction, compliance, and administrative control.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang closes by locating imaginative courage and mission in unconditional love with his wife, not in institutional prediction authority.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Human Heart owns the relational counterweight to collapse anxiety when love opens imagination, agency, and service.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this May 7 interview as a late public synthesis after the March-April Iran-war cluster: Jiang repeats that Iran cannot be treated like Iraq, calls it a mountain fortress suited to attrition, and connects Hormuz/GCC exposure to the petrodollar and global economy.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint owns route, energy, fortress terrain, pressure-point warfare, and exit-cost mechanisms. Prediction owns the dated forecast claims and later comparison; Power As Alchemy owns the dollar only when monetary belief itself is the active object.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the four-point U.S. strategic reordering as Imperial Retrenchment pressure: fortress America, allied burden transfer, China containment through Malacca/First Island Chain tolls, and defense-industrial revival.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Retrenchment owns fortress/resource/industrial reordering. Chokepoint owns Malacca or First Island Chain only when access-control is the active diagnostic.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add this source to several existing comparison families rather than promote any one ledger item immediately: Iran-war loss and attrition, Trump third-term/emergency-powers paths, Russia entering the Iran conflict, China-U.S. deal claims, December draft/Selective Service claims, AI surveillance state, Greater Israel, Odessa/carbohydrates, Japan/Taiwan war pressure, and five-to-ten-year American collapse timing.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns dated horizons, audit trails, speculation caveats, and comparison before ledger promotion. Neighboring pages own the mechanism once a forecast family is routed.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the AI surveillance passage as a May 2026 public version of the database-control grid: online life is recorded, inferred, and fed into systems for prediction and control.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns database administration and control. AI As Control Surface owns obedience through interface and religious imagination; Attention owns imagination dependency and focus capture.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the bankers-versus-tech-bros section as support for AI control as a worldview interface: Palantir, Ellison, Thiel, and OpenAI/Stargate are framed as actors seeking control over people's imagination in a war over reality.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: AI As Control Surface owns the interface/control-of-imagination layer. Mass Society owns administrative databases; Secret Society owns hidden coordination only if the source is about trust networks rather than public tech power.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Preserve the closing counterweight: collapse anxiety becomes ethical practice, and unconditional love opens imagination, courage, mission, and service.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns relation, love, imagination, and service. Free Will may receive agency language, but the source's closing mechanism is relational rather than solitary choice.

new_lens_seeds.title: World War As Reality War
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A global conflict becomes a war over reality when state, finance, tech, media, and religious projects fight not only over territory or currency but over the imagination through which populations decide what world they inhabit.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source explicitly says the conflict is not just between nation-states but over the fundamental nature of reality, then names bankers, tech actors, AI/Stargate, media power, and competing eschatological visions. Keep it as a held seed until compared with Stories, AI Control Surface, Attention, Secret Society, and Prediction sources.

chronology_notes.note: This 2026-05-07 interview is later than the March-April Iran-war cluster and should be treated as a public synthesis/checkpoint, not as the origin of the no-exit, Hormuz, draft, emergency-power, or AI-surveillance claims.

The source places several forecast families under one interview frame, but they have different horizons and routes: immediate Iran attrition and Russia-expansion claims, December draft/Selective Service claims, 2028 Trump-path claims, Taiwan/Japan claims, and five-to-ten-year U.S. empire-collapse claims should not be collapsed into one ledger item.

canon_candidates.candidate: The United States is forced into Iran war to preserve the petrodollar/Treasury system, but Iran's terrain, population, Hormuz leverage, and attrition strategy mean the U.S. loses or is trapped in a global-cost shock.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with March 3, March 9, March 13, March 20, March 24, April 18, April 21, and April 24 Iran-war sources before any ledger promotion.

canon_candidates.candidate: The U.S. strategy is to harden the Western Hemisphere, shift burdens to allies, pressure China through Malacca and the First Island Chain, and revive defense manufacturing while absorbing debt through a reordered world map.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Route first through Chokepoint and Imperial Retrenchment comparison; promote only if later public events or Jiang sources make the four-point sequence ledger-ready.

canon_candidates.candidate: Trump may pursue a third-term path through emergency war powers, succession/vice-president routing, election manipulation, or 2028 legal pressure while domestic polarization and draft politics intensify.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with the domestic Rubicon/draft/emergency-powers record; preserve the legal uncertainty and interviewer pushback rather than treating each route as the same claim.

canon_candidates.candidate: The world is already in a World War III catalyst moment because competing world visions and U.S.-Russia conflict will expand outward, potentially drawing Russia into the Iran war and turning it into a long war of attrition.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with later or earlier Russia/Iran escalation sources and preserve Jiang's drawn-out process/no concrete flashpoint caveat.

next_actions.action: Do not create a standalone World War 3 page from this source. Use it as a comparison hub: Chokepoint for Iran/Hormuz/Malacca access, Imperial Retrenchment for fortress/resource/industrial reordering, Prediction for dated claims, Mass Society for AI surveillance, AI Control Surface for imagination-control interface, Eschatology for Greater Israel/ending roles, and Human Heart for the closing relation-and-service counterweight.

If a provenance pass follows, start with exact links from the existing read marks to Chokepoint no-exit/strait anchors, Mass Society digital-permission grid, and Human Heart relation anchor; avoid linking every broad geopolitical mark.
